Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Jazz.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Jazz (revenge).
Bottom line: the Lakers win 80 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 207 and 255 total points.

edges: Doncic: more scoring (38.4 vs 23.0 per 36 min)
Grimes has played 53 fewer minutes in the last 7 days
Thybulle has played 39 fewer minutes in the last 7 days
LaRavia has played 39 fewer minutes in the last 7 days
Sensabaugh: more scoring (21.0 vs 8.6 per 36 min)
Kessler has played 44 fewer minutes in the last 7 days
Kessler is more rested (Bamba played yesterday)

analyst.text: Utah snapped a 12-game losing streak on Tuesday as Brice Sensabaugh scored 40 off the bench against the Clippers, so they arrive with some life despite the back-to-back. JJ Redick expects Walker Kessler to play against the team that traded him, and Austin Reaves will try to return from his heel bruise; the Lakers are also on a back-to-back. The angle leans towards the Lakers.
